websiteDescription:
Designed to organise rod and reel combinations. Utilises rod hanger to lock rod tips in position plus adjustable 316 grade stainless steel spring pin reel hanger which securely locks reel in position. Reel hanger is easily adjusted to suit a wide range of trolling reels and provides a base which ensures rods do not dislodge in rough conditions. Hidden installation screws and rounded edges present a clean smooth look. Can be vertically or horizontally mounted and are ideal for overhead saloon or bridge mounting, under gunnels or in rod lockers.

• Concealed fasteners and rounded edges 
• Horizontal or vertical mount

A simple but effective device that eliminates water surface reflection, to allow under water viewing as far as water clarity and light permits. Works in two ways, firstly the clear acrylic lens breaks through the water surface reflection, secondly the light blocking cone, with soft rubber face piece, eliminates reflection on the tempered glass lens, to provide clear viewing.
